page.layout: One title page: centred text block within an ornamental woodcut frame (border at top, bottom and both sides). Printed lines are centred inside the frame.

l.i: De quibus, Deo benigne juvante, & Theologici ordinis in illustri Acade-
mia Basiliensi Decano permittente, Christiana συμβίβασις[?] institue-

page.notes: Decorative woodcut frame with floral and foliage ornament at top and bottom, and with grotesque figures, masks and foliage on the vertical side columns; ornamental rule and printer's fleuron separate the author/respondent lines from the imprint. Handwritten marks are not transcribed: "314" struck through and "35." top right, and "27 Sept." at the foot. Library oval stamp (Universitätsbibliothek Basel) at lower right, not transcribed. The Greek word is read as συμβίβασις; the letters are small and partly worn, so it is marked [?]. The date "cIↄ Iↄ XCIII." is printed in the old reversed-C form and is given as MDXCIII.
